title: Exclusive Birthday Perks for Spa Members
description: As a valued member of the Elements family, we’re thrilled to celebrate your birthday with an exclusive lineup of luxurious treats just for you.

blocks.html:
🎉 Celebrate YOU this month! 🎉
Enjoy gifts, discounts, and more from Elements Wellness. Exclusive perks just for your special day!

FREE TREATMENT UPGRADES 🌟
Complimentary upgrade of Aromatherapy during massage & Omega Light Therapy during facial.
*Redeemable once during the birthday month.

BIRTHDAY MONTH SAVINGS 💆‍♀️
Enjoy 50% OFF any à la carte facial treatment.

FACILITY ACCESS ♨️
35% OFF ala carte rates for Koyamaki Onsen Therapy (Elements Centrepoint) / Contrast Therapy or Herbal Bath (Elements 313)
*Pre-booking is required.

BIRTHDAY GIFT 🎁
Receive a travel size Elements Skincare serum or Antedote Essential Oil when you spend at least $500 annually.

*Gift to be collected in-store during the birthday month | While stocks last.

ELEMENTS BEAUTY VOUCHER 🎉
Receive $100 Elements Beauty Voucher when you spend $800 during your birthday month.

PRODUCT VOUCHER 🛍️
Receive $20 OFF retail product purchase when you spend $100 during your birthday month.

INVITE A FRIEND 👫
Bring a friend, and they’ll enjoy 40% off à la carte treatment rates.

* Booking is required.

T&Cs:

• One-time redemption per perk during birthday month.
• Valid only for the name registered under the package.
• Perks are non-transferable and valid only for the birthday month.
• Facilities subject to availability, advance booking required.
• Not valid with other promotions, privileges, discount cards or promotional vouchers.
• Elements Wellness reserves the right to amend any of the terms and conditions without prior notice
To make an appointment via call / WhatsApp, select your preferred outlet. (This is usually faster.)
